name: Metal Forming & Deformation Processing
summary: Covers rolling, forging, extrusion, drawing and sheet forming, and how hot and cold working shape both the part and its microstructure.

topics.name: Mechanics of forming: flow stress, friction and work of deformation
Hot working vs cold working; dynamic recovery and recrystallisation
Rolling: flat and shape rolling, roll forces and thermomechanically controlled rolling
Forging: open-die, closed-die and isothermal forging
Sheet-metal forming: bending, deep drawing, stretching and springback
Formability: forming limit diagrams and r-value anisotropy
Superplastic forming and diffusion bonding (aerospace titanium)
Severe plastic deformation: ECAP, high-pressure torsion and ultrafine grains
Machinability of materials and surface integrity (materials view)
